verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents percentage rollouts and progressive rollouts that release features incrementally. Its guarded rollouts progressively increase traffic until reaching 100%, and community users confirm rollouts by percentage of users. Flag changes stream to clients over SSE, so ramping doesn't require a redeploy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of consistent/sticky bucketing (deterministic hashing by context key), evidence of 1%-granularity steps, and any detail beyond the doc titles on how the percentage rollout is configured.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying

citations.quote: This topic explains how to create and manage progressive rollouts to release new features incrementally.
A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions until the rollout reaches 100%.
custom rollout by % of users or attributes, centralized feature flag service via SSE with minimal latency
Percentage and attribute rollouts (e.g. 10% of users in Rhode Island) are also supported.
